caption: The drawing depicts a central oval framed by a red and blue twisted border. Inside the oval, a human figure with a light face and hands, wearing a wide-brimmed black hat, red jacket, yellow trousers, and brown boots, is seated on a brown horse facing left. The figure holds a red flag in the right hand and a sword in the left hand. Above and around the person and horse is an arching curtain composed of alternating red and blue stripes with green decorations. Below the horse and figure is a stylized, wavy ground, decorated with blue leaf-like patterns, curved brown shapes, and scattered circular motifs. Outside the oval frame, floral and leaf decorations occupy each corner, with green leaves and red flowers or buds, and two red-and-yellow wavy patterns along the left and right sides. The background of the entire drawing consists of closely spaced, horizontal gray lines. The edges are bordered by a blue line, and the bottom left corner contains the number "45" written in small, black script. The words "TERRA AMATILLA" appear along the lower right side of the oval, and "AN" on the lower left side.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
